title: Saboteur-92 World Chunk
description: Intermediate, LLM-friendly representation of a single world chunk. Terrain/decoration geometry is separated from entities. Tile values are simple integer PALETTE ids (0..N) resolved against tile_id_map.json; -1 (empty_id) means no tile. Grid coordinates are chunk-local cells (origin top-left). See docs/world_chunk_bridge.md for the setup guide.

schema_version.description: Schema version; bump on breaking changes.

chunk_id.description: Stable id, e.g. 'chunk_03_03' or 'sector_1_corridor'. Also used as the root Node2D name.

grid_size.description: [width, height] of the chunk in cells. Saboteur-92 chunks are [128, 72].

cell_size.description: Pixels per cell (native, pre-scale). Saboteur-92 uses 8.

empty_id.description: Palette id that marks an empty cell. Default -1.

tile_id_map.description: res:// path to the palette/lookup config that maps palette ids back to Godot TileSet atlas tiles and layers to TileSets.

layers.description: One entry per authored TileMapLayer, keyed by layer key (snake_case, see tile_id_map.json layer_order). Layers absent here are created empty by the loader. Terrain vs. decoration is expressed by each layer's 'role' in tile_id_map.json; collision semantics live in the dedicated 'collision' layer.

entities.description: Gameplay objects, enemies and triggers. Kept fully separate from terrain geometry.

meta.description: Free-form provenance/authoring notes (source file, generator, seed, etc.).

encoding.description: 'grid' = dense 2D array [height][width] of palette ids (-1 = empty). 'rle' = row-major run-length pairs [value,count,value,count,...] over width*height cells.

data.description: Tile payload, shape chosen by 'encoding'. Palette ids are indexes into tile_id_map.json palettes[layers[key].palette].tiles.

cells.description: Optional: number of non-empty cells (informational / validation aid).

data.description: Flat [value,count,...] pairs: even length, every count >= 1, counts summing to width*height. JSON Schema cannot express the pairing; ChunkValidator.decode_layer enforces it.
Exactly grid_size[1] rows of grid_size[0] ids each (checked by ChunkValidator).

type.description: Logical entity type resolved to a prefab via tile_id_map.json/entity_prefabs: spawn, guard, alarm_guard, key, document, bomb, invuln, sabotage_target, exit, marker, interlock, locked_lift, passage.

id.description: Optional stable id, used for the spawned node name and cross-references.

position.description: Chunk-local position in CELLS (grid units). The loader multiplies by cell_size to get native pixels.

params.description: Type-specific fields named after the prefab's properties (item_type, required_item, patrol_distance in native px, label, ...), set verbatim by WorldBuilder. origin='top_left' + size_px mark actors positioned by their sprite's top-left corner.
